observations: Photo 0 shows a marine outboard/inboard-style engine assembly with the flywheel/belt pulley area visible and heavy external wear/dust.
The engine appears partially disassembled or missing some covers/hoses; wiring and components look exposed.
No clear model/serial plate is readable in the photo.
The seller’s text says “Detriot 671 marine engine”, but the photo does not show a readable “Detroit 671” marking.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable engine nameplate/model plate or any clear “Detroit 671” text.

risks.risk: Engine may not be complete (missing covers/parts) or may have internal damage not visible externally.
risks.proof: Video of a cold start (or at least cranking) plus close-ups of the intake/exhaust manifolds and any missing mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to run / possibly incomplete.

risks.risk: Unknown hours/maintenance history; marine engines can have corrosion/salt damage.
risks.proof: Photo of the engine serial/model plate and service records (or a logbook), plus inspection photos of coolant passages and heat exchanger area (if accessible).

risks.risk: Seller’s model identification may be wrong (photo doesn’t confirm “Detroit 671”). Wrong model changes parts availability and value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the identification plate (brand/model/serial) and a photo of the engine casting/model markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case generic/unknown marine engine value.

risks.risk: Major components may be seized or worn (crank, bearings, turbo if present, injection pump). External appearance can’t confirm.
risks.proof: Compression test results (or cylinder leak-down) and a mechanic’s report after inspection.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the engine nameplate/serial plate (brand + exact model) and the casting/model markings.
Send a short video showing the engine cranking (starter engaged) and, if possible, a start with stable idle.
Provide photos of all sides showing completeness: fuel system, alternator, starter, exhaust manifold, and any missing covers.
Provide compression test (or mechanic inspection report) and any service/maintenance history.
response.reason: The photo does not confirm the exact engine model/brand, and the visible condition suggests possible incompleteness or non-running risk. Without proof of identity and running/health, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
